title: Good Looking Silverware
text: Good Looking Silverware. My daughter just moved into a new apartment. Last year she lived with 3 other roommates and they had communal silverware. She thought she had a few random pieces, but after being in the new place for a week, she asked me if I could find her a full set. She was very pleased with this one. The quality is very good. She loves the modern design on them. It's kind of like a hammered metal look. This is a full set and includes 8 place settings of 5 - soup spoon, regular spoon, table knife, salad fork, dinner fork. Each setting came individually packaged in a fabric drawstring bag. She plans to use them for when she has to take her lunch with her and needs silverware.
